annotation.bound_parties_text: The resolution encourages and calls upon States to pursue efforts and cooperate voluntarily, and requests the Secretary-General to seek views and report; it imposes no binding obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Encourages States to pursue national, regional, subregional and global efforts to address the opportunities and challenges
annotation.dates_quote: Resolution adopted by the General Assembly on 24 December 2024
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Artificial intelligence in the military domain and its implications for international peace and security
